content:
Alongside AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off and AirPods Max 2 at $120 off,, today we are tracking the very first discount on the brand new Apple HomeView over at Amazon. It’s not a giant deal, but you might as well save some cash on your pre-order. We are also highlighting the new Apple TV Siri Remote (4th generation) – upgrade your existing Apple TV setup for $59 instead of buying the next-generation Apple TV 4K at $299. From there, it’s all about the accessories – the 2026 Magic Keyboard at an all-time low, loads of Apple iPhone 18 Pro case deals, a chance to add AirTag 2 to your HomeView setup at the Amazon low, and more.

New Apple HomeView: First pre-order discounts now live at Amazon

Apple unleashed its exciting new HomeView smart display yesterday, pre-orders are now live, and Amazon has already dropped the price lower than everyone else.

Amazon is now offering the brand new Apple HomeView starting down at $289.99 shipped.

  • Apple HomeView Space Gray $289 (Reg. $299)
  • Apple HomeView Starlight $289 (Reg. $299)

That’s clearly not a giant discount or anything, but it is lower than everywhere else and you might as well keep a couple cups of coffee in your pocket.

Considering this is a whole new product category for Apple (for the most part), it isn’t taking trade-ins against this thing at all. So if you’re going to pre-order one, there’s really no benefit of doing so at Apple now that it is lower at Amazon.

As of right now, only a couple colors of the new HomeView are marked down and the Wall Mounted edition is still at full price, but we will keep a close eye on the listings as we move through the day.

Save $240 and just upgrade your existing Apple TV setup with the new Siri Remote at $59

Apple has officially unleashed the new HomeView smart display and HomePod mini 2 for pre-order, as well as the new, and particularly expensive Apple TV 4K. If you are not ready to drop $299 for the upgraded Apple TV experience, you can at least upgrade your existing setup with the all-new Apple TV Siri Remote (4th generation) for just $59.

No, this is not technically a deal by any means – $59 is the list price on the new Siri Remote. But if history is any indication deals on this thing are going to be incredibly rare and it’s a whole lot less pricey than buying a whole new Apple TV 4K that includes this same remote.

The new Apple TV Siri Remote (4th generation) is not only compatible with new Apple TV 4th Gen, but also the Apple TV HD and the previous-generation Apple TV 4K.

AirPods Pro 3 currently $50 off at Amazon, AirPods Max 2 $120 off

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (Reg. $549)

Score Apple’s 2026 Magic Keyboard for your new Mac mini setup at the Amazon all-time low

Alongside pre-orders for the new HomeView smart display, HomePod mini 2, and Apple TV 4K, this month ushered in all-time low pricing on the 2026 Magic Keyboard you might need for your new M6 Mac mini. And it is still down at the Prime Day all-time low.

Considering how rare deals can be at times on Apple’s official Magic accessories, we wanted to highlight this deal on the new all-glyph model once again while it is still live.

Regularly $99, you can pick one up over at Amazon down at $79.99 shipped right now. That might not seem like a notable discount, but when it comes to Magic Apple accessories, especially this soon after release, it is.

Official Apple iPhone 18 Pro cases now up to 25% off, all-time lows from $37

The new HomeView smart display, next-generation Apple TV 4K, and HomePod mini 2 are now available for pre-order, but we are also tracking all-time low pricing across the latest Apple iPhone 18 Pro case lineup. Select models, like the new Olive 18 Pro Silicone case have now dropped again to a new Amazon all-time low at 25% off, and you’ll find loads more with deals below.

While most colors and models are still at the Prime Day lows we featured last week, the Apple iPhone 18 Pro Silicone Case with MagSafe in the new Olive colorway has now dropped even lower to $36.75 shipped. That’s 25% off the regular $49 list price and the lowest price we have tracked to date.

Bring tracking capabilities to your HomeView setup while AirTag 2 is at the Amazon low

Apple unleashed its new HomeView smart home display today, bringing together all of your compatible smart home gear and Apple products into one centralized hub. It happens to integrate nicely with AirTag 2 for tracking down personal items and you can still score one of those at the Amazon all-time low.

Amazon is still offering Apple’s latest AirTag 2 down at $24 Prime shipped. Just shy of 20% off, this is on par with the lowest price we have tracked on Amazon for a single AirTag 2.

While this deal has been live for a while, we wanted to make sure it was on your radar now that HomeView has arrived. AirTag 2, of course, works just fine without HomeView, but it also expands the capabilities of Apple’s new home hub, allowing users to simply ask HomeView to ping your misplaced keys or bag as your rushing out of the door, for example.

The 4-pack of Apple’s latest AirTag 2 is also marked down to $89 shipped right now for the lowest possible price per Tag at $22.25, but we have seen it down at closer to $80 a few times over the last month or so.

You can still score Apple’s mid-range M6 Mac mini at nearly $150 off if you’re quick

While AirPods Pro 3 are now at $50 off, AirPods Max 2 are still at the Prime Day price with $120 in savings and this mid-range 512GB M6 Mac mini is the last of Apple’s brand new machines still at the nearly $150 off mark.

Amazon is still offering Apple’s brand new M6 Mac mini with 16GB of RAM and the 512GB SSD down at $949.99 shipped.

This is a regularly $1,099 machine sitting at $149 off to land within $1 of the lowest price we have tracked to date online.

It dropped to $150 off for fall Prime Day, which was the very first particularly notable discount. And while many of the configs have started to jump up in price now, this one is still very close to the lowest price we have tracked to date and among the most notable Apple Prime Day deals we tracked for this year’s fall sale event.
